purpose: Single repository entrypoint covering root invariants, development method, every active CB6 specification, development basis, progress, dependencies and evidence.
authority_rule: This ledger is an index. Requirements originate in active_decisions/current_spec; technical truth and completion are established only by referenced evidence and executable verification.

root.rule: No lower-layer implementation/build may be authoritative until executable Root Certification succeeds.

sequence: implementation and audit as one change unit
change_rules: required change records reason/impact/authority before implementation

status_semantics.PENDING_RECERTIFICATION: Existing work is preserved. Revalidate it under the certified Root/Method; do not restart implementation unless evidence proves it invalid.

status_semantics.DEFERRED_WITH_EVIDENCE: Unresolved work was intentionally deferred and must retain achieved state, reason, restart point and completion condition.

defer_policy.final_rule: No FINAL acceptance while a deferred item is unresolved unless the active requirement explicitly permits that item to remain deferred.
defer_policy.no_restart_rule: Recertification never means restart from zero. Preserve valid implementation/evidence and restart at the earliest affected unresolved stage.

completeness.claim: Master is incomplete until atomic requirement reconstruction and repository/history coverage both pass zero-omission verification.

source_inventory.role: known failure classes, mandatory process and recurrence history
real-device accepted/historical behavior with supersession rules
feature impact and real-device acceptance map

known_failure_classes.summary: Renamed/changed flow leaves stale audit/test/workflow/APK expectations.
Literal escaped newline contaminates generated/validator source.
Later apply/configure step restores obsolete behavior.
Mark constructor group differs from clear/show/publish group.
Successful APK is not behavioral/device acceptance.
Network supplementation added where native MWM already owns data.
Time/chat/task change must not drop mandatory rules or state.
Changed behavior and validator diverge despite earlier process rule.

order_rules.requirement_mapping_required: Every active product requirement must map to one or more explicit development-order rows; process requirements may govern the whole pipeline.
order_rules.dependency_override: Order may change only with recorded reason/impact/dependency evidence; silent reordering is forbidden.

atomic_requirement_registry.completion_rule: Every valid detailed CB6 specification must be represented atomically and mapped to a development stage, parent active decision/authority, progress/evidence and acceptance route. Count alone never proves completeness.
